item.title: Funeral director wins A$48,966 after employer sacks him over police clearance
item.description: A 65-year-old Australian funeral director was dismissed after police revoked a clearance required for body-transfer duties he had stopped performing months earlier. The Fair Work Commission found the dismissal unfair, noting that the employee was unlikely to resume the work and that the employer had not properly challenged the police decision. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: 314 years after Dutch ship sank off Australia, 23 stolen silver coins return from California and Amsterdam
item.description: After extensive efforts, Australia has reclaimed twenty-three silver coins from the infamous Zuytdorp shipwreck, which was lost at sea in 1712. The recovery operations spanned both the Netherlands and the United States, revealing a surge in illicit interest since 2019. In light of this, Australian authorities ramped up their monitoring, culminating in local resident Ashley Patterson's guilty plea for breaching underwater heritage laws linked to these invaluable artifacts. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
